SELECT b.* FROM business AS b
AND b.status = 4
AND b.id = #{businessDTO.businessId}
AND b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessDTO.name}, '%')
AND b.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessDTO.phone}, '%')
AND b.subject = #{businessDTO.subject}
ORDER BY b.update_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS business_total, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS business_wait_allot, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS business_wait_follow, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS business_following, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS business_false, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 END) AS business_convert_customer FROM business
